# DareBay

> Платформа, где люди и бренды публикуют задания на контент, авторы снимают свои ролики и получают награду по реально набранным просмотрам. В кошельковом конкурсе средства блокируются платформой; в ручном конкурсе деньги в кошелёк DareBay не поступают, а организатор платит авторам напрямую. Два равных входа: веб (darebay.com) и Telegram.

## Русский

Материалы о заданиях на контент, участии, проверке просмотров и выплатах на DareBay.

### О проекте

- [О проекте DareBay](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/): О проекте DareBay без рекламы: кто делает платформу, где лежат деньги конкурса до выплаты, откуда цифры в разделе и куда написать, если что-то не сходится.
- [Гарантия выплат на DareBay - чем обеспечено обязательство](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/garantiya-vyplat): Гарантия выплат DareBay: бюджет кошелькового конкурса заморожен на платформе до старта, условия не меняются, цифру просмотров никто не правит. Где её границы.
- [Кто пишет гайды DareBay и откуда в них цифры](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/kto-pishet-i-otkuda-tsifry): Кто пишет гайды DareBay о нарезках и отвечает за каждую цифру: откуда ставки и пороги, как проверяются данные других площадок и куда писать об ошибке.
- [Манифест DareBay](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/manifest): Манифест DareBay: во что верит площадка, чего не терпит и что обещает. Результат вместо метрик, условия до старта, обязательство перед победителем.
- [Отзывы о DareBay - и что проверить вместо них](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/darebay-otzyvy): Почему отзывов о молодой площадке почти нет и как за десять минут проверить DareBay самому: каталог конкурсов, карточка задания, форма вывода, лицо проекта.
- [Редакционная политика раздела о заработке на нарезках](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/redaktsionnaya-politika): Редакционная политика гайдов о нарезках: один вопрос на страницу, источник и дата у каждой цифры, площадки по их документам, что не обещаем, как правим ошибки.
- [Скам в клиппинге: девять красных флагов площадки для нарезок](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/skam-v-klippinge-krasnye-flagi): Клиппинг не развод, но площадки бывают разными. Девять красных флагов, проверка площадки за десять минут и что делать, если уже заплатил за «доступ».
- [DareBay - развод или нет? Где здесь платишь ты](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/darebay-razvod-ili-net): DareBay развод или нет: участие бесплатное, комиссия конкурса 0%, платишь только за вывод баланса, 10% внутри заявки, переводов от тебя нет. И красные флаги.
- [DareBay - это скам? Разбор по признакам](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/darebay-eto-skam): DareBay скам или нет: разбор по шести признакам скам-площадки, от предоплаты до чужой цифры результата. Каждый пункт проверяется, слабые места названы.
- [DareBay в цифрах: ставки, комиссии, выплаты и страны](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/darebay-v-tsifrakh): DareBay платит от $1.00 до $2.00 за 1000 просмотров, комиссия конкурса 0%, вывод от 10 USDT с комиссией 10%, по всему миру. Все факты на одной странице с датой.
- [DareBay реально платит? Путь денег после закрытия конкурса](https://darebay.com/o-proekte/darebay-realno-platit): DareBay реально платит: сумму считает код, перевод делают люди. Путь денег от финального счётчика до вывода и что делать, если статус выплаты завис.

### Earnings

- [Earning from clipping: what it pays and how to start](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/): Clipper earnings on DareBay run $1.00 to $2.00 per 1000 views. Clear the 2000-view threshold and one clip earns up to a typical $100. Every guide, mapped.
- [Account warm-up and shadowban: a 7-day plan and what to do](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/account-warm-up-and-shadowban): Warm-up is a week of acting like a normal viewer before posting; a shadowban is lost reach after duplicates or fake views. A 7-day plan and the fixes.
- [Best clipping platforms in 2026: where clippers get paid per view](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/best-clipping-platforms): Nine clipping platforms compared on rate per 1,000 views, threshold, cap, fees, minimum payout and countries. Competitor figures from their own pages, dated.
- [Clipping as a job - how to earn from video clips](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/clipping-as-a-job): Clipping is piecework paid per view: take a brief, cut a clip, publish it and earn $1.00 to $2.00 per 1000 views in open contests. No followers, no portfolio.
- [Clipping earnings calculator: what you can make per month](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/clipping-earnings-calculator): Set views per clip, clips per week and a $1 to $2 rate per 1,000 views: you get a monthly figure with the threshold, the $100 cap and the 10% withdrawal fee.
- [Clipping glossary: the terms every clipper should know](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/clipping-glossary): Clipping is cutting streams and videos into short clips that earn per view. 52 clipper terms: CPM, threshold, cap, counted views, offers, wallet, withdrawal.
- [Clipping on Telegram: a clip channel, DareBay tasks and Stars](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/clipping-on-telegram): Clipping on Telegram pays three ways: a clip channel with a share of ad revenue, DareBay tasks taken inside Telegram and paid per view, and clipping services.
- [Clipping on X (Twitter): how X pays and how DareBay fits](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/clipping-on-x-twitter): X pays clippers through its Premium-only creator programme. DareBay does not count X views, but the same clip on TikTok, Reels or Shorts earns $1–$2 per 1,000.
- [Clipping platforms that pay in Russia and CIS: who pays where](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/clipping-platforms-that-pay-in-russia-and-cis): DareBay, Prime Oracles and Klipni say they pay in Russia and CIS; Whop and Vyro exclude the region; four platforms list no countries. Their own words, dated.
- [Clipping rates by niche and platform: the 2026 benchmark](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/clipping-rates-by-niche): DareBay pays $1–$2 per 1,000 views; elsewhere the rate follows the niche, from cents in music to dollars in fintech. Every outside figure is sourced and dated.

- [DareBay vs Whop Content Rewards: which pays you and how much](https://darebay.com/en/earnings/darebay-vs-whop): Whop is the bigger clipping marketplace but blocks Russia, Belarus and Ukraine; DareBay pays there and worldwide. Rate, threshold, cap, fees, budget compared.

### Help

- [DareBay help](https://darebay.com/en/help/): DareBay help: how a contest reward is set and paid, what the fees are, how to withdraw a balance and what protects your result. Answers before you start.
- [Can you pay with crypto on DareBay?](https://darebay.com/en/help/paying-with-crypto): Paying with crypto on DareBay means one coin: USDT on the TON network, for top-ups, budgets and withdrawals. Crypto is optional, COINS never leave it.
- [Create your first contest](https://darebay.com/en/help/your-first-contest): Your first DareBay contest takes under ten minutes: title, terms, format, selection type, prize and dates on one screen. What is locked after launch.
- [DareBay fees - contests, store and withdrawals](https://darebay.com/en/help/what-commission): DareBay fees by operation: 0% to create or top up a contest, 10% to withdraw a balance, minimum request 10 USDT. A store purchase costs 8%.
- [DareBay withdrawals - fee, minimum and timing](https://darebay.com/en/help/darebay-withdrawals): DareBay withdrawals: one request from 10 USDT, a 10% fee, details checked manually by the team, and payouts in USDT on TON or Telegram Stars.
- [How are winners chosen?](https://darebay.com/en/help/how-winners-are-chosen): How winners are chosen: one of four types, fixed before the start. A seeded draw, the organizer's own call, a viewer vote, or pay per view.
- [Prizes and payouts](https://darebay.com/en/help/prizes-and-payouts): Prizes and payouts on DareBay: money or an item as the reward, where the budget sits in a wallet-backed contest, and what happens once the result is in.
- [Protection from view fraud and fake submissions](https://darebay.com/en/help/protection-from-view-fraud): View fraud protection on DareBay: the figure is read from the public counter on the site your video went out on, and suspicious growth goes on hold.
- [Quick start on DareBay](https://darebay.com/en/help/quick-start): Quick start on DareBay: pick one of three roles and go. Launch a contest, submit work, or watch and vote. One account covers the site and Telegram.
- [Submit your work](https://darebay.com/en/help/submit-your-work): Submit work on DareBay without losing the payout: in a pay-per-view contest the entry arrives as a link to the published video, in the rest you upload a file.
- [Verification and trust](https://darebay.com/en/help/verification): Verification and ratings on DareBay: what a verified badge proves, how the organizer and participant ratings are built, and what changes when they drop.
- [Watch, vote, win](https://darebay.com/en/help/watch-vote-win): The viewer's side of DareBay: how the feed works, which contests your vote actually decides, where a like changes nothing, and what a clean record buys you.
- [What if nobody enters?](https://darebay.com/en/help/if-nobody-enters): Nobody entered? A wallet-backed budget returns to your balance in full, the 0% fee on creation and top-ups leaves nothing to refund, and your rating holds.
- [What to do about prohibited or dangerous content?](https://darebay.com/en/help/prohibited-content): Prohibited content on DareBay: where to report a work, a comment or a profile, which categories carry zero tolerance, and what a confirmed violation costs.

### Legal

- [Legal documents](https://darebay.com/en/legal/): DareBay terms of use and privacy policy - what the platform promises you and what it expects from you.
- [Privacy Policy](https://darebay.com/en/legal/privacy): What data DareBay collects, why, how long it keeps it, and how to manage it.
- [Terms of Use](https://darebay.com/en/legal/terms): The DareBay rules. What we promise, what we expect from you, and what gets you removed.
